B1_selection_rule: argmin mean_total_ms over B2 rows with successful encrypted execution; SAFE/REJECTED is not used for selection
B2_contract_rule: same byte-bound model, configuration-selection rows, decision contract, rho, margin floor, and key repeats as B4; only allowed_paths is widened to the two predeclared legacy paths

baseline_applicability.P4_MLP100: predecessor-bound seven-profile rescale catalog plus V17 B3/B4
baseline_applicability.P5_LeNet5_small: predecessor-bound seven-profile rescale catalog (7/7 PLAN_UNSUPPORTED) plus V17 B3/B4
baseline_applicability.depth_ladder: B3/B4 only; B0-B2 are not depth-complete references
baseline_applicability.tabular_P1_P3_and_ablation: B0-B4 evaluated; statically unsupported B0/B2 rows are never encrypted

baselines.B0: fixed default profile; never encrypted when Security-V2-inadmissible
baselines.B1: minimum observed latency among successfully executed frozen B2 rows without using the decision gate
baselines.B2: legacy Security-V2 admitted 7 profiles x 2 paths (14 static rows; unsupported rows preserved)

finite_oracle: B3 fastest SAFE within the frozen generated set
